flags.description: In 2022 Glencore pleaded guilty in the US to conspiracy to violate the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, admitting to paying over $100 million in bribes to officials in Nigeria, Cameroon, Ivory Coast, Equatorial Guinea, DR Congo, Venezuela and Brazil between 2007 and 2018, as part of a combined global resolution exceeding $1.1 billion.
In the same 2022 resolution, Glencore's US subsidiary separately pleaded guilty to a conspiracy to manipulate fuel oil price benchmarks at US ports via a South Africa-based trading desk.
